active.title: Active missing-person search
active.summary: Current registries, bookings, courts, news, and obituaries.

query_families.title: Arrest / booking
query_families.template: ("{name}" OR {aliases}) {jurisdiction} (arrest OR booking OR inmate OR jail OR custody)

query_families.title: Court dockets
query_families.template: ("{name}" OR {aliases}) {jurisdiction} (court OR docket OR hearing OR charged)

archives.title: Archive & old newspaper / publishing search
archives.summary: Historical newspapers, library digital collections, periodical clippings, and published archives for older mentions.

query_families.title: Old newspapers
query_families.template: ("{name}" OR {aliases}) ({year_from}-{year_to} OR {decade}) (newspaper OR "news archive" OR "from the archives" OR microfilm) {jurisdiction} (missing OR arrested OR court OR homicide OR unidentified)
query_families.notes: Prefer library/digital-archive adapters; publication date ≠ event date.

query_families.title: Books / magazines / published notices
query_families.template: ("{name}" OR {aliases}) (magazine OR periodical OR gazette OR "police gazette" OR pamphlet OR "true crime" OR yearbook) {jurisdiction_or_region}

query_families.title: Library digital collections
query_families.template: ("{name}" OR {aliases}) ("digital collection" OR "chronicling america" OR "newspaper archive" OR "historical newspapers") {jurisdiction}

query_families.title: Archived obituaries / death notices
query_families.template: ("{name}" OR {aliases}) (obituary OR "death notice" OR "passed away") ({year_from} OR {year_to} OR archive) {jurisdiction_or_region}

doe_cold.title: Cold case — John Doe / Jane Doe unidentified
doe_cold.summary: Match a missing subject against unidentified remains and public Doe notices (John Doe / Jane Doe / Unknown). Demographic compatibility only — never auto-identify.

query_families.title: Jane Doe notices
query_families.template: ("Jane Doe" OR "unidentified female" OR "unidentified woman" OR "unknown female") {jurisdiction} ({age_band} OR {sex} OR {date_window} OR {distinguishing_marks})
query_families.notes: Score as compatibility lead only; no auto-merge to named subject.

query_families.title: John Doe notices
query_families.template: ("John Doe" OR "unidentified male" OR "unidentified man" OR "unknown male") {jurisdiction} ({age_band} OR {sex} OR {date_window} OR {distinguishing_marks})
query_families.notes: Score as compatibility lead only; no auto-merge to named subject.

query_families.title: Archive Doe / unidentified clippings
query_families.template: ("Jane Doe" OR "John Doe" OR unidentified) {jurisdiction} ({year_from}-{year_to}) (body OR remains OR discovered OR homicide)

query_families.title: Later identification stories
query_families.template: ("identified as" OR "previously known as" OR "Jane Doe identified" OR "John Doe identified") {jurisdiction} ({name} OR {aliases} OR {date_window})

cold_missing.title: Cold case — long-term missing
cold_missing.summary: Long-horizon missing notices plus archives, Doe options, and historical crime/publishing searches.

query_families.title: Long-term missing registries
query_families.template: ("{name}" OR {aliases}) (missing OR "cold case" OR "still missing" OR "unsolved missing") {jurisdiction} ({year_from} OR {last_seen_year})

query_families.title: Name in historical newspapers
query_families.template: ("{name}" OR {aliases}) ({year_from}-{year_to}) (missing OR vanished OR "last seen" OR disappeared) {jurisdiction_or_region}

query_families.title: Cross-match Doe notices in window
query_families.notes: Enable when cold-case Doe option is selected.
